name: vi-humanize
description: Write and edit natural Vietnamese for the intended reader while preserving meaning and the author's voice; removes formulaic, machine-sounding, and translated-sounding patterns.

interface.longDescription: Draft, edit, review, or translate Vietnamese text so it reads naturally for its reader: correct forms of address, register by genre, no translated-sounding grammar, and no invented facts or voice.
defaultPrompt: Biên tập đoạn văn này cho tự nhiên, giữ nguyên ý.
